mapper.select: SELECT issue_id FROM loan_issue WHERE application_id = #{applicationId}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(li.issue_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, COALESCE(SUM(li.issue_amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(li.issue_id) AS count FROM loan_issue li WHERE li.issue_status = 'SUCCESS'
AND li.issue_time >= #{startDate}
AND li.issue_time <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59')
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(li.issue_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC

SELECT COALESCE(lp.product_name, '未知产品') AS productName, COALESCE(SUM(li.issue_amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(li.issue_id) AS count FROM loan_issue li INNER JOIN loan_application la ON li.application_id = la.application_id LEFT JOIN loan_product lp ON la.product_id = lp.product_id WHERE li.issue_status = 'SUCCESS'
AND li.issue_time >= #{startDate}
AND li.issue_time <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59')
GROUP BY lp.product_id, lp.product_name ORDER BY amount DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN li.issue_amount < 10000 THEN '0-1万' WHEN li.issue_amount < 30000 THEN '1-3万' WHEN li.issue_amount < 50000 THEN '3-5万' WHEN li.issue_amount < 100000 THEN '5-10万' WHEN li.issue_amount < 200000 THEN '10-20万' WHEN li.issue_amount < 500000 THEN '20-50万' ELSE '50万以上' END AS `range`, COUNT(li.issue_id) AS count FROM loan_issue li WHERE li.issue_status = 'SUCCESS'
AND li.issue_time >= #{startDate}
AND li.issue_time <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59')
GROUP BY `range` ORDER BY MIN(li.issue_amount) ASC

SELECT la.apply_term AS term, COUNT(li.issue_id) AS count FROM loan_issue li INNER JOIN loan_application la ON li.application_id = la.application_id WHERE li.issue_status = 'SUCCESS'
AND li.issue_time >= #{startDate}
AND li.issue_time <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59')
GROUP BY la.apply_term ORDER BY la.apply_term ASC
